name: PE Civil Exam Prep: Trussly
subtitle: PE Civil Practice and Mocks
shortDescription: Prep for the PE Civil exam: Construction and Water Resources depths, worked calculations, six engineering labs and timed mocks.
longDescription:
PE Civil Exam Prep: Trussly turns the long road to the Professional Engineer license into short, honest practice sessions on your phone or tablet. Study the Construction depth and the Water Resources and Environmental depth of the NCEES PE Civil exam, subtopic by subtopic.

### What You Get
- Every lettered subtopic in the NCEES specifications for these two depths: 48 in Construction and 68 in Water Resources and Environmental, 116 in all. Each has a short lesson with a worked example, cited sources, and at least 8 original practice questions with a full solution (990 questions in the bank).
- A Coverage screen that lists every subtopic with your mastery, so you always see what is covered and what is still weak.
- Questions that adapt to you: the app keeps track of how you are doing on each subtopic on your device, links every missed question back to the lesson, suggests the next best topic with a one-line reason, and lets you study in syllabus order or through guided real-world projects such as designing a retaining wall.
- Calculation questions you can answer by choosing or by typing the number. Every number was computed by code and re-checked by a second method before it shipped.
- Typeset key relations with tappable symbols, and a reference sheet of original lookup tables.
- Nine engineering labs with live pictures and guided tasks: open-channel flow, a beam with a moving load, a pressure pipe with pump, a 3D truss with colour-coded member forces, a critical-path network, a gravity retaining wall, column buckling, footing bearing capacity with settlement, and an alternatives and NPV chart.
- A diagnostic, weak-area drills, spaced review, and timed mock exams.
- Made for phones and tablets: on iPad you get a navigation rail, a wide main pane and a Today panel beside it.
- Adjustable text size from 50 to 300 percent, works offline, no account, progress stays on your device.

### Honest Limits
Covers the Construction and the Water Resources and Environmental depths only (Geotechnical, Structural and Transportation are not included). Score numbers are rough practice estimates, not an NCEES result, and the app predicts no pass or fail. The practice content was written for this app and has not been reviewed by a licensed engineer. The NCEES Reference Handbook and design standards are not included. Not a design reference for real projects.

NCEES, the Principles and Practice of Engineering (PE) exam and its exam names belong to the National Council of Examiners for Engineering and Surveying. Trussly is not affiliated with or endorsed by NCEES and contains no NCEES exam questions, solutions, handbook text or logos.
